newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's CentralPower, Electro Power plan merger.
newsitem.headline: NZ's CentralPower, Electro Power plan merger.

text.p: Unlisted North Island companies CentralPower Ltd and Electro Power Ltd said on Friday they planned a merger to create New Zealand's 10th largest electricity distribution company.
The merged company would have total assets of NZ$130 million and annual energy sales of $75 million.
Under the proposal, CentralPower would issue 19.2 million mandatory convertible notes with a face value of $43.2 million to Palmerston North City Council.
The council will transfer its 100 percent ownership of Electro Power into CentralPower and will then hold a 30.35 percent stake in the merged company.
The Council has referred the proposal to a period of public consultation.
Infrastructure and Utilities NZ Ltd (Infratil) owns 21 percent of CentralPower, which is based in the Manawatu region of the North Island.
